Glossary Terms

A Print or Digital product may contain one or more of the components below.

Print

Print products are shipped to customers. A print book may have a digital component, which can be accessed through a scratch off code inside the front cover.

  • Student Book: Coursebook available in full or split editions
  • Workbook: Practice book available in full or split editions
  • eBook: Digital version of the book that students can access online or via a mobile device.
  • Online Practice: Extra interactive activities that reinforce the print or ebook lessons and report to a gradebook.
  • Digital Resources: Depending on the product offering resources could include an app, audio program, video, and additional student resources.

Digital

Digital products are sent to customers via . These could be Access Codes or links to digital materials.

  • eBook: Digital version of the book that students can access online or via a mobile device.
  • Online Practice: Extra interactive activities that reinforce the print or ebook lessons and report to a gradebook.
  • Digital Resources: Depending on the product offering resources could include an app, audio program, video, and additional student resources.
